name: sutd-bge-large-ft67
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Fine-tune of BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 into a job-description-to-module retriever for a SUTD course-recommendation chatbot (MLOps class project, checkpoint 'ft67'). Same tensor set as the base. Recorded because the card prints both rows in one table on the same held-out set: NDCG@10 0.679 -> 0.747. Weight this accordingly: the held-out set is 10 job queries, which is a smoke test rather than a measurement, and the card's own table also prints a sibling checkpoint (sutd-bge-large-aug98) at 0.770 - higher than the checkpoint this repo actually hosts - so the repo is not the best of its own family. Treat as evidence that domain fine-tuning helped on this narrow retrieval task, not as a ranked embedding result.

benchmarks.name: NDCG@10, SUTD job-to-module retrieval held-out set
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Model | NDCG@10 |': base BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 0.679 vs sutd-bge-large-ft67 0.747. The eval set is only 10 held-out job queries, so this is a signal, not a measurement. The card also prints a sibling (sutd-bge-large-aug98) at 0.770, i.e. better than the model this repo hosts.
